subject: nereid-ass-field
q: CLOSED BY PILLAR THREE — and the missing values were never missing from a list of four. There are TWO FIELDS, not one.
detail:
ANSWERED. MOTION SIGNATURE: NATURAL, DART, SNAPBACK, LIVELY POP, HEAVY SETTLE. MOTION CHARACTER: NATURAL, SOFT, DRAMATIC, HYPNOTIC. Plus two tuning notes, RETURN SPEED and FOLLOW-THROUGH, each Subtle / Natural / Pronounced and recorded only when character-defining.

AND THE QUESTION WAS SHAPED WRONG, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHY LEAVING IT EMPTY WAS RIGHT. It assumed a single ladder of four with two slots blank. The real structure is two fields, and SWAY IS NOT IN EITHER OF THEM. HEART SWAY is what NATURAL means once a Heart has been selected, as BUBBLE BOUNCE is what it means on a Bubble. The Archive had a SHAPE-NATIVE EXPRESSION filed as a MENU VALUE — so any value it invented to complete that ladder would have been wrong twice over: a fabricated tier in a field that does not exist.

SNAPBACK survives unchanged and is a SIGNATURE: a staged return, a distinct secondary answer after the initiating movement. Bella’s authored sentence ends in SNAPBACK, which gives her Signature and leaves her CHARACTER unrecorded — NOT INVENTED HERE. See q-bella-character.
